summary: Adds a cache behind a mutex.

findings.title: Poisoned lock panics the reader
findings.explanation: unwrap on lock() panics for every later caller once one thread panicked while holding the lock.

findings.title: Lock is held across an await
findings.explanation: The guard lives across an await point, which can deadlock the executor.

findings.title: One mutex serializes all readers
findings.explanation: A Mutex blocks concurrent readers; an RwLock would let them run together.
